decision: Pulse is SvelteKit with fine-grained reactivity for live clocks and streams
why: Many small values update every second; compiled reactivity updates only what changed.
alternative: The same React stack as the shell.
value: Smooth live UI with a small bundle, and proof the architecture isn't tied to one framework.

decision: Entity resolution merges artists across scripts and platforms
why: AERA, 에아라 and エアラ are one artist with seven accounts; counting them separately splits the signal.
value: The leaderboard measures artists, not accounts.

decision: Ask Pulse streams answers with numbered citations and a link to the full trace
why: Analysts act on the answer only if they can check where each claim came from.
value: Every claim is one click from its evidence.

decision: Live clocks for LA, Seoul and Tokyo sit in the navigation
why: Every decision here is 'when, where'; the time in each market is the context.
alternative: Show times only in the user's zone.
value: Fewer scheduling mistakes across a 17-hour spread.

decision: Signals are aggregated from an event stream into per-market read models
why: Dashboards must be fast even when raw play events arrive by the million.
alternative: Query raw events for each chart.
